purpose: Generate one locked-V9-only three-pose offline source panel that remedies the rejected V30 art: each state needs a visibly different natural mouth contour and a more readable compact function silhouette at native 200x200, while V9 remains a floating face rather than a mascot costume.
v9_identity_and_simplicity_invariants: retain the exact locked V9 floating inner-face composition with wide white margins and no enclosing head, face outline, ear, hair, headband, helmet, body, frame or screen card
retain exact V9 eye silhouette, black fill, one oval highlight and one diamond sparkle per eye, eye scale, eye spacing, eye baseline, nose, cheek dots and line weight
each state has exactly three separately extractable compact object parts and no individual part larger than half a V9 eye
objects must be clean black character-bound equipment, never cover eyes or brows, and remain secondary to the face
each state has a visibly distinct, separately extractable mouth contour with different source ink geometry; moving one shared mouth by a pixel is not sufficient
objects must not be literal battery, lightning, microphone, waveform, plug, menu icon, text, label, detached UI widget or generic whole-face prop

state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: a compact composed decision mouth: one shallow closed curve with a tiny deliberate right-corner lift, clearly unlike the V9 double-wave mouth and unlike the other two state mouths
state_object_semantic_brief.accessories: three compact rounded page tabs immediately above the brows. Make the centre tab subtly higher and the three tabs visibly wider with crisp white gaps so they read as a tiny tab strip rather than dots or hair. They are left_tab, center_tab and right_tab only.
state_object_semantic_brief.choreography: tabs arrive left-to-centre-to-right, make one short decision scan with the gaze, hold, then release

state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: a tiny calm listening mouth with one soft shallow U-shaped contour, not an open O, surprise face, or the menu/charging mouth
state_object_semantic_brief.accessories: two clearly readable thin C-shaped ear-cuffs hugging the outer cheeks plus one tiny short rounded pickup capsule immediately beside the right mouth corner. Make the cuffs a little more visible through clean stroke weight and shape, not through a headband, big earcups, long boom, microphone pictogram or waveform.
state_object_semantic_brief.choreography: cuffs arrive first, make one one-pixel outward acknowledgement, pickup capsule settles, hold, then reverse

state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: a short relaxed upward recovery smile with a single smooth contour, visibly different from the menu decision mouth and recording listening mouth
state_object_semantic_brief.accessories: a compact open side clasp just outside the left cheek with a small white inner notch, one clear very short curved tether ending below the brow, and a small rounded four-point energy core above the brows. Make their connection readable at 200x200 without a large plug, battery, lightning glyph or oversized core.
state_object_semantic_brief.choreography: clasp connects, tether draws inward, energy core makes one tiny fill/settle beat, hold, then reverse

machine_preconditions_before_owner_revie: source gate proves locked-V9-only lineage, no enclosing head, exactly three declared minimal object parts, a V9 half-eye object-area limit, and pairwise mouth-mask geometry differences
component export retains exact locked V9 identity components plus source-derived face/object components only with zero overlap
browser and target PBM replay one deterministic component plan at native 200x200
internal visual preflight rejects a shared or offset-only mouth, oversized/costume-like accessories, or any state that is not readable without labels before an operator prompt
